description: This file defines the OperationManager class used to handle web service operations in the vtiger CRM system. It manages operation details, input sanitization, formatting, and execution of web service calls.

classes.name: OperationManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing web service operations, including configuration, input handling, and execution logic.

methods.name: OperationManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the OperationManager with database, operation name, format, and session manager.

methods.name: isPreLoginOperation
methods.description: Checks if the current operation is a pre-login operation.

methods.name: fillOperationDetails
methods.description: Retrieves and sets details of the specified web service operation from the database.

methods.name: fillOperationParameters
methods.description: Fetches and stores parameters required for the current operation.

methods.name: getOperationInput
methods.description: Returns the input parameters for the operation based on the request method.

methods.name: sanitizeOperation
methods.description: Sanitizes input parameters according to their types.

methods.name: sanitizeInputForType
methods.description: Performs sanitization of input data based on type.

methods.name: handleType
methods.description: Handles sanitization or processing of individual input values based on type.

methods.name: runOperation
methods.description: Executes the web service operation with given parameters and user context.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes data using the specified format (e.g., JSON).

methods.name: getOperationIncludes
methods.description: Returns list of files to include for the operation.
